name: io.github.mojomaxmojo/mojobus
title: MojoBus Travel Blog
description: Read-only MCP server for the MojoBus vanlife travel blog by Max & Susanne — 14 years of vanlife across Europe, focus Portugal/Algarve. Search 750+ travel reports, campsites and places (prices, coordinates, practical infos), trips with GPS routes, and the latest feed. German & English. No authentication required — read-only, hallucination-safe.
